---
title: "Value Box Demo"
format:
    revealjs:
        output-file: index.html
filters:
    - value-box
---


## Simple boxes 1

::: {.value-box .bg-amber style="font-size: 1.25rem;"}

**Value boxes**

A simple value box can help convey points...

:::

Or display a metric

::: {.value-box value=60}
Number of bibbles bobbled this week
:::

## Simple boxes 2

Or display a metric with an icon

::: {.value-box value=60 icon="bi-arrow-down-up" icon-size="2rem"}
Number of bibbles bobbled this week
:::


::: {.value-box icon="bi-arrow-down-up" color="bg-amber" width="60%" align="center"}
Here's a more advanced type of box with an icon and some formatting, but no value
:::


## Fragment types

::: {.value-box value="Big text" icon="bi-arrow-down-up" icon-size="2rem" color="bg-olive" width="60%" align="center" fragment="fade-in-then-semi-out"}
We can use them with special named fragment types like 'fade in, then semi out'
(this is also the default if you set fragment="true")
:::

::: {.value-box value="Big text" icon="bi-arrow-down-up" icon-size="2rem" color="bg-olive" width="60%" align="center" fragment="fade-in-then-out"}
Or standard fragments
:::

:::{.fragment}
Tada!
:::




## Complex icon box layouts with index parameter

:::: {.columns}

::: {.column width="50%"}
### Left Column
::: {.value-box fragment="true" index="2" width="70%"}
This appears SECOND (Index 2)
:::
:::

::: {.column width="50%"}
### Right Column
::: {.value-box fragment="true" index="1" width="70%"}
This appears FIRST (Index 1)
:::
:::

::::


## Icon position

::: {.value-box icon="bi-star" icon-position="left" color="bg-blue" value="42"}
Left-aligned icon
:::

::: {.value-box icon="bi-star" icon-position="right" color="bg-green" value="99"}
Right-aligned icon
:::

::: {.value-box icon="bi-star" icon-position="bottom" icon-size="1.5rem" color="bg-red" value="7"}
Icon below text
:::

## Text Position

We can also combine this with text position

::: {.value-box icon="bi-star" icon-position="left" align="right" color="bg-blue" value="42"}
Left-aligned icon with right-aligned text
:::

::: {.value-box icon="bi-star" icon-position="bottom" icon-size="1.5rem" color="bg-red" value="7" align="center"}
Icon below text, all centred
:::

## And we can use different icon types

:::: {.columns}

::: {.column width='50%'}

::: {.value-box icon="bi-star" icon-position="left" color="bg-blue" value="42"}
Bootstrap icons
:::

:::

::: {.column width='50%'}

::: {.value-box icon="fa-brands fa-python" icon-position="left" color="bg-blue" value="42"}
Font awesome icons
:::

:::

::::

:::: {.columns}

::: {.column width='50%'}

::: {.value-box icon="example-icon.svg" icon-position="left" color="bg-grey" value="42"}
Local svg file
:::

:::

::: {.column width='50%'}

::: {.value-box icon="example-icon.png" icon-size="256px" icon-position="left" color="bg-blue"}
Local png file
:::


:::

::::


## Width

We can manually override the width.


::: {.value-box icon="fa-brands fa-python" icon-position="left" color="bg-blue" value="42"}
No width specified - defaults to 80% of container
:::

::: {.value-box icon="fa-brands fa-python" icon-position="left" color="bg-blue" value="42" width="30%"}
Width of 30% specified.
:::




## Height

And we can manually override the height.

:::: {.columns}

::: {.column width='50%'}

::: {.value-box icon="fa-brands fa-python" icon-position="left" color="bg-blue" value="42"}
Example with no height specified - it will fit the contents
:::

:::

::: {.column width='50%'}

::: {.value-box icon="fa-brands fa-python" icon-position="left" color="bg-blue" value="42" height="500px"}
Example with height of 500 pixels (500px) specified
:::

:::

::::
